svg.title: Runtime and Trust Topology — light theme
svg.desc: A runtime topology that distinguishes the browser and CLI clients, Vite development proxy, FastAPI application, protected and restricted protocol surfaces, Temporal orchestration, and lazily started helper processes. Sources: .env.template; client/vite.config.js; server/main.py; server/middleware/auth.py; server/routers/websocket.py; server/services/authz/ws_surface.py; server/services/cli_agent/mcp_server.py; server/services/temporal/lifecycle.py; server/nodes/code/_runtime.py
svg.text: Development and production paths, authenticated surfaces, durable orchestration and lazy helpers

g.title: Loads SPA in development · via HTTP :5678
Launches and administers · via Typer / process
Calls protected routes · via HTTPS + JWT cookie
Commands and receives status · via WebSocket + cookie
Invokes scoped tools · via MCP over HTTP + Bearer
Delivers provider events · via HTTPS webhook
Dispatches authenticated message · via ASGI WebSocket
Calls legacy node handlers · via WebSocket
Starts workflows and polls tasks · via Temporal gRPC :5681
Starts on demand and executes JavaScript · via HTTP :5682
